See docs/asset-pipeline.md. externalFonts are separately sourced, committed Transport fonts and licences; the original-art extractor leaves them untouched.

83x24 gold-framed plate; the cream field runs x 5..77, y 5..18, so the frame is a uniform five pixels on every side. Measured with --probe, not chosen.
The same plate with a green field. The pair is the original's own available/selected state, which is why the theme's pressed style is this rather than a tinted copy of the first.
A band of the Terrain Map frame's top rail, away from both corners and above the gold inlay at y 24. Horizontal grain, so it tiles across a wide border and is never stretched.
The right toolbar column of the same frame, whose grain runs vertically. Kept separate from wood_fill because tiling a horizontal grain down a column reads as a stack of planks.
One of ten 60x56 tabs the original cut itself, seen assembled down both columns of screen frame 4300.
